package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/url"
)

// scenario for url_parse_in_loop_on_invariant_base: url.Parse(...) or ParseRequestURI(...) observed inside loops with a stable-looking base input.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.
func scenario372Positive(paths []string) ([]string, error) {
	var results []string
	for _, path := range paths {
		u, err := url.Parse("https://api.example.com/" + path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		results = append(results, u.String())
	}
	return results, nil
}
